item.title: L55 Tacos among latest closures at Westfield UTC
item.description: A modern Mexican eatery in the Westfield UTC mall in University City has closed less than two years after it made its debut, adding to the growing list of closures at the shopping center as it continues its luxury expansion project.

item.title: San Diego woman who bought Porsche and $2.9M home with stolen funds sentenced to prison
item.description: A woman from the Point Loma neighborhood of San Diego will spend time behind bars after she admitted embezzling and laundering millions of dollars from her employer.

item.title: 2 people in hospital with serious injuries after crash in National City
item.description: National City police asked the public to avoid a busy intersection near Interstate 805 Friday afternoon due to a traffic collision with possible injuries.

item.title: Oceanside Unified rolls out live translation tool to support English learners
item.description: The Oceanside Unified School District has launched a new live translation tool, Clear Connect, to help students learning English by translating a teacher's lesson instantly into a student's native language.

item.title: Bloom and gloom: Local flower shop braces for potential flooding amid busy Valentine's season
item.description: Native Poppy, a flower shop in San Diego, experienced its second flood in two years, which hit the store ahead of Valentine's Day, one of their busiest days of the year.

item.title: Deputies search for suspicious man who allegedly tried to lure boy in El Cajon
item.description: The San Diego County Sheriff's Office is investigating a report of a suspicious man in El Cajon who allegedly tried to get an 8-year-old boy to enter his vehicle.

item.title: Northbound lanes of Texas Street to close Friday night for repairs
item.description: The city of San Diego is closing a portion of Texas St. from Friday night to Saturday morning to repair a stormwater channel and stabilize the embankment ahead of anticipated rain next week.

item.title: San Diego cardrooms pushback against California's new Blackjack ban
item.description: California cardrooms could face a major hit come April 1, as new regulations will bar them from offering blackjack-style games, which could result in job losses and decreased revenue for local communities.

item.title: Winter storms to bring heavy rain and mountain snow to the San Diego area starting on Presidents' Day
item.description: San Diego is expecting a sunny and warm Valentine's Day weekend, but a large area of low pressure will bring light to moderate rain to the area on Monday, with periods of heavy rain expected.
